title: CreatedAt Precedes ReadyAt
description: A report job's own timeline should hold together under scrutiny — it was requested before it was ever ready, never the other way around, and the gap between the two should roughly match the queue delay it actually waited through.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs and record wall-clock time T0. Poll until status is "ready". Querying report_jobs via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms created_at is at or after T0 (within a small margin), ready_at is strictly after created_at, and the gap (ready_at - created_at) is roughly consistent with NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS (default 500ms — allow generous slack for actual query/generation time, but it should be on the order of that delay, not e.g. multiple seconds or negative).
hints: NOTIFICATION_QUEUE_DELAY_MS also governs report job timing per docs/api/reporting.md — it's the same queue notifications use.
select ready_at - created_at from report_jobs where id = '<id>'; gives you the interval directly in psql.
